messages:
Nina: Quick alert  noticed invoice-preview variance for a small set of tenants after we pushed routing change at 02:40 UTC. Token totals +1.2% median. Anyone seen dup metering events?
Rob: Looking. Traces show two metering envelopes for same request_id when route fallback occurs across regions. One uses route_tag=eu-west, another route_tag=us-west.
Casey: We intentionally scoped fingerprint to include route_tag for plan-rate differentiation. But fallback should not emit second bill.
Nina: Short-term fix: preserve original_request_id header across redispatch so billing uses same id. Also consider adding stable `billing_id` field.
Rob: Consumer dedupe currently keys on fingerprint which includes route_tag; changing that is invasive. Prefer emitting a stable billing_id and let consumers dedupe on that.
billing-bot: alert: invoice_preview_delta > 0.3% for 12 tenants in prod (see INC-2026-119) :rotating_light:
FinanceLead: If a backfill on preview numbers is needed, require simulation + audit log. No write without dry-run.
Nina: Plan: (1) emit billing_id from edge (canary 5%), (2) extend dedupe window for canaried tenants to 10m, (3) run simulation for 48h and post CSV.
Casey: I'll open RFC to remove route_tag from fingerprint long-term and store variant as metadata.
Rob: I'll add Grafana panel: `rate(metering.duplicate_events[5m]) / rate(metering.events[5m])` and alert at 0.25% sustained.
Nina: Assigning tasks: Rob -> edge canary deploy; Casey -> RFC + PR; FinanceLead -> approve simulation; Nina -> console banner for affected tenants. React with :thumbsup: when done.
